description: Displayed repainted as 62-7427; the real 62-7427 was an F-86F-30 with wing fences that was displayed here until it was swapped for this fence-less F-86F-40 between 1980 and 1986 and then scrapped; shown clean with no tanks or pylons
Previously displayed at Izu Bio Park and at Meitec in Hyogo before coming to Gifu
The T-2 special-specification aircraft and the last JASDF T-2 flown; final flight 2 Mar 2006; stored until put on outdoor display 20 Feb 2017
Part of the PR display group at the SW of the base
surface_to_air Live-configuration round near the display group at 35.3920N 136.8499E
The first JASDF Phantom; retained at Gifu after the type's retirement in March 2021
Held at Gifu outside the main display group
The last flying JASDF F-4EJ; front cockpit parts reused to make a walk-in cockpit exhibit in the Gifu base PR room
